newsitem.title: GERMANY: Talks with Veba on Asta Medica likely - Degussa.
newsitem.headline: Talks with Veba on Asta Medica likely - Degussa.

text.p: Germany's Degussa AG said it may discuss the future of its pharmaceuticals unit Asta Medica AG with its new major shareholder Veba AG but said it was no nearer moving to list the unit separately.
"A listing for Asta Medica was always an option. But there is no reason to bring that forward now," Degussa chief executive Uwe-Ernst Bufe told Reuters Financial Television.
Bufe said, however, that Degussa would have more room to discuss opportunities to increase its potential in areas including pharmaceuticals with its new shareholder.
Veba on Wednesday announced plans to buy a 36.4 percent stake in Degussa, pending cartel authority approval.
